findings.title: Unmetered public LLM endpoint
findings.recommendation: Remediated with bounded parsing and strict widget/IP/client quotas.

findings.title: Google Sheets OAuth tokens stored in plaintext
findings.recommendation: Remediated with APP_KEY decryption and legacy token migration.

findings.title: Unbounded and schema-bypassing public form submission
findings.recommendation: Remediated with bounded parsing, an allowlist and strict quotas.

findings.title: Persistent HTML injection in embedded widget
findings.recommendation: Remediated by assigning tenant-controlled text through textContent.

findings.title: Known vulnerabilities limited to development dependencies
findings.recommendation: Migrate the Tailwind/ESLint toolchain and exclude dev dependencies from runtime.
